name: Example submission profile
description: A worked example of the profile format. Copy it, put your own project's expectations in options, and map whatever checklist you are answering - a regulator's codes, a client EIR, a BEP acceptance criteria - onto the rule ids in checks. Run `python ifc_audit.py --rules` to see the ids.

checks.title: One schema and one MVD across the set
checks.note: the MVD is read from the file header, which some exporters write from the schema rather than from the view setup chosen - check the export setup itself before acting on it

checks.title: Spatial hierarchy is rooted
checks.note: IfcProject at the apex, IfcSite below it, and every building, storey and space aggregated into the one above it

checks.title: Every element is on a storey
checks.note: containment is inherited down a decomposition, so the parts of an assembly count as contained by whatever holds the assembly

checks.title: Models share one survey point
checks.note: compares the resolved real-world anchor, not only the declared IfcMapConversion values

checks.title: Elements say what they are
checks.note: IfcClass and PredefinedType only; required property sets are not read yet

checks.title: No hard clashes between disciplines
checks.note: bounding-box overlap, not a solid intersection - a smell test, so do not report it as clash detection

checks.title: Storey names and levels agree across models
checks.note: levels are compared in the survey datum, so a model carrying the offset in its IfcSite placement is comparable with one carrying it in IfcMapConversion. A same-named level differing by less than storey_datum is reported as a datum difference to confirm - finished floor level against top of concrete - rather than as a fault.

checks.title: Rooms are modelled as spaces
checks.note: IfcSpace presence and which storey each space sits on. How much of each storey floor area is covered by spaces is a 2D polygon union and is not checked yet.

checks.title: Required property sets on every element
checks.note: nothing checks this yet - IfcPropertySet is not parsed. Listed so the gap is visible in the report instead of being silently absent.
